name: alchemical_separation_of_semiprimes_into_their_constitutive_primes

phase_0.boundary_condition: The semiprime N = p × q forms a closed multiplicative container; the factorization process opens this container via Frobenius comultiplication, extracts the prime factors through the route ladder, verifies their product reconstructs N via Frobenius multiplication, and reseals the boundary with the fixed invariant of unique factorization.

⊢.justification: Before any semiprime is named or loaded, the computational state is void — no integer, no factors, no verification status exists (dimensionality 𐑼 = point-like).

⊣.justification: The semiprime N acts as a composite container (topology 𐑰) that bounds exactly two prime factors in a hierarchical multiplicative tree; TANCH anchors this closed boundary as the terminal container for the operation.

≻.chosen_element: factorization algorithm (route ladder: trial division → ECM → GNFS)
≻.justification: The forward morphism advances from the composite semiprime toward its prime constituents through irreversible structural decomposition (relational 𐑑), transforming N into the pair (p, q) via the descent through Hermetic spheres.

≺.justification: The reverse morphism descends from the candidate factors back to the original semiprime by multiplying them, clearing the register of intermediate state while retaining the open Frobenius frame for the return (polarity 𐑹 = special Frobenius, μ∘δ=id).

⋈.chosen_element: compositional link between factorization and verification
⋈.justification: CLINK chains the forward factorization and reverse verification into a single sequential process that preserves the return structure (fidelity 𐑐 = high, I_net > 9 bits), ensuring the split factors recombine to the original N.

⊙.chosen_element: self-recognition of semiprime as product of its primes
⊙.justification: The semiprime knows its own prime structure; IMSCRIB inscribes this identity (N = p × q) into the operation itself, making the factorization available to its own verification (criticality 𐑢 = subcritical, deterministic).

∈.chosen_element: semiprime N splitting into prime factor arms p and q
∈.justification: Frobenius comultiplication δ opens the composite N into two arms: the T-arm carries the first prime factor p, the F-arm carries the second prime factor q (granularity 𐑲 = local, single event).

∋.chosen_element: verified recombination of p and q into N
∋.justification: Frobenius multiplication μ fuses the transformed arms back into the single state N, rejoining p and q through the multiplication check; conflicting evidence on arms rejoins to B, but correct factorization rejoins to T (composition 𐑝 = conjunctive).

⊤.chosen_element: prime factor confirmed (p is prime, q is prime)
⊤.justification: Deposits constructive truth T on each arm when the candidate factor passes primality testing — affirmative evidence that the arm holds a genuine prime.

⊥.chosen_element: candidate factor rejected as composite or verification failed
⊥.justification: Deposits constructive falsity F when a candidate factor fails primality testing or when p × q ≠ N — negative evidence triggering backtracking or algorithm continuation (chirality 𐑓 = achiral, no persistent symmetry breaking).

⊞.chosen_element: dialetheic state when factorization evidence conflicts
⊞.justification: Holds both T and F simultaneously (B state) when probabilistic and deterministic tests conflict, or when semiprime is a prime power creating ambiguity; the Brass Vessel (stoichiometry 𐑳 = asymmetric) contains this contradiction without explosion.

⊡.justification: Permanently fixes the winding invariant (protection 𐑭 = integer-winding) of the verified factorization N = p × q as an append-only ROM record; the Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic guarantees this invariant cannot be continuously deformed.

phase_2.split_element: semiprime N splitting into prime factor arms p and q via FSPLIT (∈)
phase_2.split_input: the composite semiprime N as a single multiplicative object
split_outputs: T-arm: first prime factor p with primality evidence deposited by EVALT
F-arm: second prime factor q with primality evidence deposited by EVALT
phase_2.fuse_element: verified recombination of p and q into N via FFUSE (∋) and multiplication check
phase_2.fuse_result: the single state N reconstructed from verified primes p and q; T+T→T (success), T+F→F (verification failed), conflicting→B (dialetheic)
phase_2.failure_reason: Tri-ancestral reconnection over a transformed object — closes

phase_3.void_description: no semiprime loaded, no factors computed, no verification attempted — the empty computational state before initialization (00)
phase_3.true_description: semiprime successfully separated into two verified prime factors p and q with p × q = N confirmed — affirmative factorization complete (01)
phase_3.false_description: factorization failed — candidate factors are composite, or p × q ≠ N, or no factors found within bounds — negative result (10)
phase_3.both_description: dialetheic state: factorization algorithm produces probable primes but deterministic proof incomplete, or semiprime is a prime power (p = q) creating ambiguity between distinct and repeated factors, or probabilistic test conflicts with deterministic check — both success and failure evidence held simultaneously in the Brass Vessel (11)

steps.domain_action: initialize void computational state — no semiprime, no factors, no verification
inscribe the self-referential identity of the semiprime as a composite container awaiting factorization (self-modeling gate)
anchor the semiprime boundary N as the closed multiplicative container (topology 𐑰) that will hold the operation
split the semiprime N into two arms — T-arm for first prime factor p, F-arm for second prime factor q (Triangle of Art)

on T-arm, execute forward factorization morphism via route ladder — Saturn (Trivial) restricts, Jupiter (SieveLane) certifies winding, Mars (DifferenceOfSquares) decomposes, Sun (WindingBridge) severs, Venus (CongruenceSieve) attracts, Mercury (OrderWinding) reverses, Moon (Rho) discovers cyclic structure
on T-arm, deposit T when primality test confirms p is prime (Affirming Witness)
on F-arm, execute forward factorization morphism to compute candidate q = N/p via same route ladder
on F-arm, deposit T when primality test confirms q is prime (Affirming Witness)
on either arm, if probabilistic and deterministic tests conflict, engage B-state holding both prime and composite evidence (Brass Vessel)
compose the two factor computations into a single sequential verification structure (Divine Name)
execute reverse morphism — multiply p × q to verify reconstruction of N, clearing register but retaining open Frobenius frame (Ascent)
if p × q ≠ N, deposit F on the fused result (verification failed, Broken Symmetry)
if p × q = N, deposit T on the fused result (verification succeeded, Affirming Witness)
fuse the verified arms back into the single state N — rejoining T+T→T, T+F→F, or conflicting→B (Fundamental Return)
inscribe the verified identity N = p × q into the operation as self-recognition of unique factorization
permanently fix the winding invariant of the unique factorization as ROM record (Final Seal, protection 𐑭)
close the semiprime boundary with the fixed factorization sealed inside — operation complete (License to Depart)

phase_5.compiler_frontend: the factorization algorithm selector (trial division → ECM → GNFS) that translates the semiprime bit-length into concrete computational operations via the route ladder
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: the Frobenius split/fuse channels carrying prime candidates between factorization and verification arms, with CLINK composing the forward/reverse passes
phase_5.memory_mechanism: the register holding the semiprime N, candidate factors p and q, and the Belnap evidence state (N/T/F/B) across the split/fuse cycle
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: the route ladder (Saturn→Jupiter→Mars→Sun→Venus→Mercury→Moon→Ogdoad) determining the order of factorization methods and verification steps
phase_5.alfs_store: the unique factorization theorem (Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic) as the canonical bootstrap store guaranteeing the invariant

phase_6.cycle_cost: computational work of factorization (subexponential for GNFS, polynomial for verification) and the Landauer cost of fixing the IFIX record
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: semiprime N as unstructured composite with unknown factors — high algorithmic entropy
phase_6.post_cycle_state: verified factorization N = p × q with fixed invariant — low algorithmic entropy, structural order restored
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — the factorization process is entropy-conservative because the information gained (prime factors) exactly equals the information lost (composite ambiguity), and the unique factorization theorem guarantees the cycle N → (p,q) → N is information-preserving; the IFIX record fixes the invariant without thermodynamic cost beyond Landauer minimum

⊣=𐑰: The IMASM execution confirms the semiprime N operates as a Frobenius container that splits into two prime-factor arms (p, q) and fuses back through multiplication verification, realizing a branched tree of multiplicative containment.
⊢=𐑼: The IMASM sequence opens with VINIT (⊢) initializing a single semiprime register as a discrete computational unit, and the factorization route ladder operates locally on one semiprime at a time without extended spatial, temporal, or scale-collapsed propagation.
⊞=𐑳: The factorization separates one semiprime into two distinct prime factors (asymmetric 1→2 participation), and the ENGAGR operation (⊞) holds contradictory evidence in a Brass Vessel that asymmetrically contains both T and F without symmetric pairing.
⊡=𐑭: The IFIX operation permanently fixes the unique factorization invariant as a ROM record, and the Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic guarantees this discrete integer winding number cannot be continuously deformed.
⊙=𐑢: The factorization process is a deterministic, subcritical computation with no scale-free correlations or critical thresholds, operating in a normal regime where the semiprime's structure is algorithmically resolved without phase-transition sensitivity.
⊥=𐑓: The factorization yields an unordered pair of primes with commutative multiplication (p × q = q × p), exhibiting no persistent orientational symmetry breaking or handedness in the separation process.
≻=𐑑: The forward morphism (≻) executes the factorization algorithm as an irreversible structural transformation that decomposes the composite semiprime into its prime constituents, matching bond formation/structural transformation.
≺=𐑹: The reverse morphism (≺) executes multiplication verification p × q = N that completes the Frobenius cycle μ∘δ=id, realizing the special Frobenius symmetry where split and fuse are exact inverses over the transformed semiprime.
⋈=𐑐: The CLINK operation composes factorization and verification into a deterministic mathematical process where the multiplication check p × q = N fires with mathematical certainty (I_net > 9 bits).
⊤=𐑧: The semiprime remains kinetically frozen as a composite until the factorization algorithm (external driving via the route ladder) overcomes the high computational barrier to rearrange it into primes.
∈=𐑲: The FSPLIT (∈) operates on a single semiprime as an isolated event, splitting it into two prime-factor arms without propagating influence to other numbers or across a broader system.
∋=𐑝: The FFUSE (∋) recombines the two prime-factor arms (p and q) only when both are simultaneously present and verified, as the multiplication check p × q = N conjunctively requires both factors to reconstruct the semiprime.
